question: Who among the following is related to the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin gharana of Kathak?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Pandit Birju Maharaj.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj (born Brijmohan Nath Mishra; 4 February 1938 – 16 January 2022) was an Indian **dancer, composer, songster, and exponent of the Lucknow "Kalka-Bindadin" Gharana of Kathak dance in India.**
 
• He also rehearsed Hindustani** classical music and was a voice.**
 
• Birju Maharaj was a philanthropist of the** Padma Vibhushan, India's second highest civilian honor, in 1986.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Subrahmanyam:**

 
 
• Dr. Padma Subrahmanyam entered her training in Bharatanatyam under the education of Vazhuvoor Ramaiah Pillai and Mylapore Gouri Amma. An exponent of Bharatanatyam, Dr. Padma Subrahmanyam has presented her art across the world, sharing in prestigious public and transnational carnivals of dance.
 
• She has won multitudinous accolades including the Padma Shri, the Padma Bhushan( 2003), the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award( 1983), the Kalaimamani, and the Kalidas Samman.
 
 
 
• **Sonal Mansingh:**
 
 
• Sonal Mansingh is a prominent Indian classical dancer who specializes in Bharatanatyam and Odissi.
 
• She was the youthful philanthropist of Padma Bhushan in 1992.
 
• In 2003, Sonal came to the first Indian woman dancer to be awarded Padma Vibhushan.
 
 
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh:**
 
 
• Right from his nonage Guru Bipin Singh entered ferocious and elaborate training in the art of Manipuri dancing.
 
• practitioner Bipin Singh was awarded numerous prestigious awards among which were Nrityacharya by Maharaja of Manipur, National Sangeet Natok Academy awards given by Late Indira Gandhi, Uday Shankar Fellowship Calcutta, Kalidas Samman Madhya Pradesh, Anamika Kala Sangam Awards Calcutta and numerous others.
